title: Does Claude’s Constitution Have a Culture?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the language model's responses to 55 World Values Survey (WVS) items using both direct survey questions and naturalistic advice-seeking scenarios, then comparing the model's value profile to empirical country-level data from 90 nations to identify WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic) baseline skews. The study also measures cultural steerability by testing if prepending specific country contexts to user prompts alters the model's substantive advice.
